topPRs.title: op-acceptance: Add DSL to allow pausing the batcher
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Inserts a proxy between the sysgo op-batcher and op-node to allow tests to restrict the batcher's view of the chain and thus pause submitting batches for blocks past a specific block number. This can then be used to provide fine grained control over batch submission.

topPRs.title: feat(op-node): add NUT bundle parser for JSON-defined upgrade transactions
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
# Summary

Adds the ability to define network upgrade transactions via JSON files instead of requiring a dedicated Go file per hardfork. 

The work is done in two commits:

1. 9b50510 — Introduces ParseNUTBundle and NUTBundle.ToDepositTransactions(), which parse a JSON file into typed structs and convert them into serialized DepositTx transactions.
2. 363c6cc - Each transaction gets a unique source hash derived from "<forkName> <index>: <intent>", using the existing `UpgradeDepositSource` mechanism.

topPRs.title: test(contracts): convert GovernanceToken tests to fuzz tests
topPRs.author: devin-ai-integration
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Converts all 9 hardcoded tests in `GovernanceToken.t.sol` to fuzz tests, replacing fixed values with bounded fuzz parameters for broader input coverage. No new tests added — `GovernanceToken` only declares `constructor()` and `mint()` as public functions, both already covered.

**Changes per test contract:**

- **`GovernanceToken_Mint_Test`**: `test_mint_fromOwner_succeeds` now fuzzes `_account` and `_amount`; `test_mint_fromNotOwner_reverts` now fuzzes `_caller`
- **`GovernanceToken_Uncategorized_Test`**: All 7 inherited-function tests (burn, burnFrom, transfer, approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance) converted to fuzz with appropriate bounds

**Bound rationale:**
- Mint amounts bounded to `type(uint224).max` (matches `ERC20Votes._maxSupply()`)
- `increaseAllowance` params bounded to `type(uint128).max` each (prevents sum overflow)
- `decreaseAllowance` initial bounded to `type(uint192).max`, decrease bounded to initial

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the `type(uint224).max` bound for mint amounts correctly reflects `ERC20Votes._maxSupply()` — if the OZ version used differs, this could silently pass with an incorrect ceiling
- [ ] Confirm removing the unnecessary `mint()` call from `approve`, `increaseAllowance`, and `decreaseAllowance` tests doesn't lose any meaningful coverage (these functions don't depend on token balance)
- [ ] Run `just test-dev --match-path test/governance/GovernanceToken.t.sol -v` with higher fuzz runs (e.g., `FOUNDRY_FUZZ_RUNS=1000`) to increase confidence in edge cases

### Notes
- Inline comments documenting specific hardcoded values were removed since they no longer apply to fuzz parameters
- The `pre-pr` `semver-lock` failure is a pre-existing repo issue (missing source files for `OPSuccinctFaultDisputeGame.sol`, etc.) — unrelated to these test changes
- Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/11157c6808504be4bf6fbb19f8204d0f
- Requested by: @aliersh

topPRs.title: feat: move feature compatibility validation to Features lib
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
**Description**

This is a baby step towards centralizing feature compatibility validation within a single library.

It does not attempt to be general or easily expandable, but our use case is very simple at the moment: we just have two features that need to be kept separate.

It also doesn't attempt to handle compatibility between DevFeatures and SystemFeatures.
